tasks.label: dab: docker compose up (api)
tasks.command: docker compose up -d db redis api

tasks.label: dab: wait for docker vm service port
tasks.command: bash -c 'port="${DART_VM_PUBLIC_PORT:-9181}"; for i in $(seq 1 90); do nc -z 127.0.0.1 "$port" 2>/dev/null && { echo "VM service ready on port $port"; exit 0; }; if [ $((i % 10)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "Waiting for VM service on port $port ($i/90)..."; fi; sleep 1; done; echo "Dart VM service port $port not open (check: docker compose logs api)" >&2; exit 1'

tasks.label: dab: wait for docker api health
tasks.command: bash -c 'port="${API_PUBLIC_PORT:-9080}"; url="http://127.0.0.1:$port/health"; for i in $(seq 1 90); do if curl -sf "$url" >/dev/null; then echo "API healthy at $url"; exit 0; fi; if [ $((i % 10)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "Waiting for API at $url ($i/90)..."; fi; sleep 1; done; echo "API not healthy at $url (check: docker compose logs api)" >&2; exit 1'

tasks.label: dab: docker stack ready for debug
dependsOn: dab: wait for docker api health
dab: wait for docker vm service port
